title: Add --wait-for-expression for JS-predicate waits
description:
A caller waiting on a condition that is not a CSS selector or body text has to poll from outside. The mako2 employee-hours E2E suite polls the iframe's own window flag (_initIframePageDone, engine2.tpl's 'chrome rebuilt' signal) every 250ms via repeated eval, because --wait-for takes a selector and --wait-for-text takes body text; neither can express 'this JS expression is truthy'.

Shape would mirror the existing waits: --wait-for-expression '<js>' evaluated in the frame from --wait-for-frame/--frame, polled to --timeout, failing with the last value seen.

Deliberately deferred: the caller's poll loop works, this is convenience not a blocker, and it was raised while their suite was one green run from done. Pick it up deliberately rather than mid-flight.
close_reason: Implemented standalone and action-scoped JavaScript predicate waits in 1.12, including frame, file/stdin, async, and timeout last-value diagnostics.
